description: Alterations including erection of a roof extension to main rear roof, and erection of part single storey, part two storey rear extensions.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed extensions, due to their scale, design and massing, would result in an over dominant, bulky, jarring and inappropriate development, that would result in the loss of historic fabric, diminishing the character of the existing building and harming its appearance and significance, and the character and appearance of this part of the West Putney Conservation Area. The proposal would therefore fail to accord with policies LP1, LP3 and LP5 of the Local Plan and with Section 72 (1) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, Policy HC1 (C) of the London Plan (2021) and paragraphs 212 and 215 of the NPPF (2024).

Reason : 2 - The proposed development would result in an unacceptable loss of residential amenity through increased overlooking, and the significantly increased height, bulk and massing of the development would create an overbearing and visually dominant form of development, which would lead to an increased sense of enclosure, reduced outlook and increased overshadowing. The proposal would therefore fail to accord with the requirements of policy LP2 of the Local Plan 2023 and the Council's Housing SPD.

Reason : 3 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan consisting of the Core Strategy, Development Management Policies Document, Supplementary Planning documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
